sentences.en: Holly Black was born in a decrepit Victorian house in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 霍莉·布莱克出生于新泽西州一座破旧的维多利亚式房子里。

sentences.en: Your body will become decrepit, and your brain will refuse to direct it.
sentences.zh: 你的身体会变得衰弱，大脑也会拒绝指挥它。

sentences.en: The old man sat in a decrepit chair by the window.
sentences.zh: 老人坐在窗户边一把破旧的椅子上。

senses.zh: 衰老的，老朽的，破旧的,头童齿豁,衰朽,蓬头历齿

mnemonic: 词根记忆：de（加强）+crepit（爆裂）→破裂不堪→破旧的
